childhood_bmi.note: Aggregate measurements of Primary 1 and Year 8 pupils, classified using International Obesity Task Force growth charts. P1 pupils were aged 4 years 2 months to 6 years 2 months; Year 8 pupils 11 years 2 months to 13 years 2 months. Pandemic-related missing years and incomplete trust coverage limit historical comparisons. See the publisher methodology before comparing years or areas.

company_insolvencies.note: Calendar-month registered company insolvencies, not seasonally adjusted. Five procedure counts sum to the total; do not add the total again. Moratoriums, restructuring plans and administration-to-CVL conversions are separate series and are not added. Counts are administrative events, not individual people, insolvency rates or forecasts. Monthly statistics may be revised. England-and-Wales combined figures are not relabelled as either nation.

pharmacies.attribution: NHS Business Services Authority, Pharmacy Openings and Closures, NHSBSA Open Data
pharmacies.note: Pharmacies on NHS England Pharmaceutical Lists providing NHS prescriptions and pharmaceutical services. Stocks are at month end; openings, closures and net changes cover that calendar month. Ownership changes count as a closure and an opening. Backdated amendments and group changes can affect comparisons between releases. Counts are premises, not patients or prescription volumes.
